_doc: MPCController robot geometry/limits and MPC tuning, loaded via --robot-spec=<path>. Absent keys keep the compiled defaults (mpc::RobotSpec::defaults()/mpc::MpcParams::defaults()); unknown keys produce a stderr warning but do not fail loading. The MPC prediction horizon (mpc::kHorizon in include/mpc/MpcCore.h) is a compile-time constant and is intentionally NOT configurable here.
